query: 'SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk,
       dp.paciente_key,
       dd.departamento_key,
       COALESCE(dg.diagnostico_key, dgn.diagnostico_key) AS diagnostico_key,
       CAST(CONVERT(varchar(8), a.admission_date, 112) AS int) AS fecha_ingreso_key,
       CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE CAST(CONVERT(varchar(8), a.discharge_date, 112) AS int) END AS fecha_alta_key,
       a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id,
       DATEDIFF(day, a.admission_date, a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia,
       1 AS conteo_admisiones
FROM silver.admissions a
JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp ON dp.patient_id_bk = a.patient_id
JOIN gold.dim_departamento dd ON dd.nombre_departamento = a.department
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT admission_id, icd_code, diagnosis_description, severity
    FROM (SELECT admission_id, icd_code, diagnosis_description, severity,
                 ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY admission_id ORDER BY diagnosis_id) AS rn
          FROM silver.diagnoses) x
    WHERE x.rn = 1
) pd ON pd.admission_id = a.admission_id
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dg
       ON dg.codigo_icd = pd.icd_code
      AND dg.descripcion_patologia = pd.diagnosis_description
      AND dg.nivel_severidad = COALESCE(pd.severity, 'Sin clasificar')
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dgn
       ON dgn.codigo_icd = 'N/A' AND dgn.descripcion_patologia = 'Sin diagnostico'',
